1.

How mighty and how patient Is our Defender! On the Father’s throne He sits, Our Advocate. Surrounded here by weakness, By need and temptation, To Him we turn ourselves, That He may give us strength.

2.

And if we stumble, fall, In this land of sin, He Himself uplifts our soul With gentle, divine hand. Then in the Father’s ear Is heard the voice of Jesus Christ, And the sorrowing child receives Forgiveness and comfort.

3.

But long before we feel Our sin’s dreadfulness, Jesus has faithfully prayed For our restoration. Thy precious grace we praise, Our heart’s praise we give Thee, In service unwearying, Our Advocate!
